column1: # screen field batch 10: GameScreen, slice 2 - the GL pipeline, the camera and the pointer state.
# createGlResources() names the program plumbing: spriteShaderProgram's "a_position"/"a_texCoord"
# binding of the two shared textures (aA = getTilesTexture(), aB = getUnitsTexture()), the one
# BatchRenderer of the screen (aZ = getHudRenderer(), whose texture feeds MinimapPanel) and
# useFloatVertices (aJ, true on Desktop/WebGL, selecting the float stride 16 vertex layout instead of
# The buffers: terrainVertexBuffer/terrainIndexBuffer (aK/aL, built once from the grid),
# spriteVertexData (aM, the 1536-short scratch block) with spriteVertexOffset/spriteVertexCapacity
# (aN/aO) and the ring of eight spriteVertexBuffers/spriteIndexBuffers (aQ/aR) rotated by
# spriteBufferIndex (aP, (aP+1) % length after each flush), plus the lineVertexBuffer/lineIndexBuffer
# render() pins the camera/pointer fields: cameraPosition (as, the Vec3 whose x/y are the scroll
# offset), cameraZoom (O; at 0.5 the camera snaps to even coordinates), the pointer tile
# pointerTileX/pointerTileY (B/C, from IsoMathHelper.toTileX/Y), the click marker clickedUnit (E)
# with its screen position clickMarkerScreenX/Y (F/G) shown until clickMarkerUntilTime (D, set to
# visibleMaxTileY (H/I/J/K, -cameraOffset .. + viewport / cameraZoom + 1) and the camera position
# remembered when a drag starts, dragStartCameraX/dragStartCameraY (bY/bZ).
# minimapWidth/minimapHeight (ay/az) are the full map extent in pixels on the minimap texture
# (128 and 64 pixels per tile for width and height).
